headlines.title: ChatGPT can peek at your Chrome tabs now
headlines.summary: OpenAI's ChatGPT Atlas browser is gone, but now ChatGPT's Google Chrome extension is getting some upgrades that allow it to use the browser tabs you already have open. With the extension installed, OpenAI says ChatGPT can now view your browser tabs when you tag Chrome in ChatGPT's web or desktop app, posting a demo…

concept.title: AI Agents
concept.body: An agent is a model given tools and a goal, allowed to take multiple steps on its own — searching, calling systems, and acting. Power rises, but so does the need for guardrails and oversight.
concept.takeaway: Deploy agents on bounded, reversible tasks first; require approval before anything costly or irreversible.
